maddie_marketing: Quick idea for the launch posts + workshop: run a compact PLG micro-pilot tied to signups. Goal = increase first-successful-prompt rate and shorten time-to-first-success.

maddie_marketing: Outline:
- 3k free credits reserved for workshop signups
- deliver a 4-item prompt template pack at signup
- 3 lightweight nudges across 7 days (email + in-console + challenge)
- arms: control / credits-only / credits+pack+nudge

leo_growth: routing question: how do we tag inbound so they hit the experiment?

maddie_marketing: auto-tag cohort=launch-pilot for workshop signups, enroll until 3k or 30d.

anya_product: primary metric = % that runs prompt.execute with template_id within 7 days. target +6pp.

nina_analytics: fine. i'll need experiment_id on events and will build dashboard.

sam_design: UX: first-login modal with 3 featured templates + "Try" CTA. i'll drop quick mocks.

leo_growth: allocation? power calc matters. if baseline ~18% we need more in treatments.

nina_analytics: recommendation: 25/37.5/37.5 unless we expand sample. I'll post numbers.

eng_ops_bot: experiment created: exp.launch_pilot.1767778881 | cohorts: control/credits/full | allocation set | tag experiment_id=exp.launch_pilot.1767778881

maddie_marketing: action items: confirm budget (maddie), modal copy + mock (sam), follow-up rules (anya), dashboard + SQL (nina), outreach list for top signups (leo). I'll greenlight tomorrow unless objections.
